forecasting_origin_scenario.definition: At the end of completed week t, the system forecasts demand for week t+1.
forecasting_origin_scenario.lagged_business_feature_availability: Lagged business metrics (lag_1_sales, lag_1_profit, lag_1_orders, lag_1_customers) are fully available under the 1-step rolling setting because week t has completed.
forecasting_origin_scenario.horizon_limitation: These lagged business features would NOT be available for a long-horizon 52-week-ahead forecast without separate exogenous projections.

sample_size_comparison.sample_size_limitation_note: ML requires 52 observations to initialize lag_52, reducing effective training samples from 156 to 105. This represents an inherent structural difference between model classes.

decision_outcome.outcome: Outcome C: Machine Learning performs worse than Holt-Winters and SARIMA

accuracy_gap_vs_holt_winters.conclusion: Holt-Winters is +22.0% more accurate than the best ML model (Ridge) and +41.0% more accurate than Tree Ensembles.

decision_outcome.tree_model_underperformance_cause: Tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) are piecewise-constant step functions bounded by training targets and fail to extrapolate the +25.9% YoY upward volume growth into 2017, causing substantial underprediction bias (+25 to +34 units).
